integrity: Pairwise resistance formulas, the quadratic decomposition, constrained minimum and eigenvalue inertia have direct analytic proofs. Finite exact-arithmetic and numerical checks support but do not replace the universal proof. Publication priority and literature completeness are not independently established.
scientific_limitations: Unit-conductance complete multipartite graphs with three or more nonempty parts. The result decides Euclidean embeddability of effective resistance itself and the centered Gram inertia at exponent two; it does not evaluate all other maximal negative-type exponents and does not cover weighted interclass conductances or noncomplete graphs. A plausible early resistance-distance paper could not be read in full; absence of an equivalent result there is not established.
title: Exact Euclidean criterion and one-obstruction theorem for complete multipartite resistance metrics
